states.title: The top two dimensions are close
states.copy: Use the current Code as your primary reference, while also considering the combination of activity clues with the first two dimensions swapped. You are not "another Code"; the two interest entry points are close.

states.title: The second and third dimensions are close
states.copy: The third dimension is not just a peripheral detail. It may determine whether this combination of activity clues ultimately focuses on materials, expression, real people, goals, or order.

states.title: Multiple dimensions are close
states.copy: Look at activities first, rather than letters. When multiple dimensions are close, what really helps is using small tasks to observe which kinds of activities appeal to you more.

states.title: An alternate code to consider
states.copy: An alternate code is a reading aid, not a second answer. It helps you understand how the emphasis within a combination of activity clues shifts across different orders.

user_visible_boundary: An alternate code is a reference for reading alongside the result. It does not overturn the result, and it is not a new identity label.
